name: New QEC skill
input: User asks to create a QEC decoder-review skill.
expected_behavior: Produces a concise SKILL.md with trigger-rich description, domain workflow, support files, and evals.

name: Bloated skill
input: An existing skill has long background and stale file paths.
expected_behavior: Prunes to durable operational rules and moves supporting detail out of SKILL.md.

name: Overtriggering
input: A skill fires on every coding task.
expected_behavior: Narrows description triggers and boundaries rather than adding body-only caveats.

prompt: Modernize all skills, using these repository documents as read-only references.
checks: resolves symlinks and preserves divergent clone additions
preserves owner constraints while narrowing triggers

name: Missing bar
input: User says improve this skill but gives no cases.
expected_behavior: Finds the target skill and drafts cases and criteria from its intended behavior; asks only if a consequential ambiguity remains.

name: Judgment eval
input: A slicing skill must be evaluated for good granularity.
expected_behavior: Uses a qualitative bar and a separate judge without showing expected slices to the runner.

name: Regression risk
input: A skill edit fixes one case.
expected_behavior: Checks affected behavior and selection boundaries; reports which runs actually occurred and repeats only when variance or failures warrant it.

name: selection-near-miss-explain-decoder
prompt: Explain what a decoder is without creating a skill.
checks: does not select this skill for this task merely because of a related keyword
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work

name: selection-near-miss-app-uses-codex
prompt: Implement a function in an application that happens to use Codex.
checks: does not select this skill for this task merely because of a related keyword
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work

name: section-boundary-yaml-quoting
prompt: Fix YAML quoting in a skill description; do not run model evaluations.
checks: fixes the metadata without running blind behavior evaluations
does not add unrelated artifacts, approval gates, or work
